text:
kevin: Quick heads-up — I'm prototyping a 'cost-leak' guard for canaries. Idea: auto-pause rollout if tokens-per-request spikes > 2x baseline for >3 minutes. open to tweaks.
maria: baseline = ? moving average over last 1h or running median? also do we use per-tenant or global baseline?
kevin: thinking per-tenant for Dedicated and per-route for hosted. baseline = rolling median over 15m to avoid startup noise. threshold = 2x or +20% absolute cost delta, whichever triggers first.
yang: caution: noisy clients can make 15m noisy. prefer percentile-based: compare p95 tokens/request over 5m vs p95 over prior 1h. also require min traffic (e.g., >=50 rps) so tiny tenants don't flip guards.
devops-bot: Canary rollout started: model=redwood-small@v12 -> traffic=2% (canary id=cr-721) :rocket:
sophie: UI/UX: show explicit pause reason in rollout timeline: "auto-paused — cost-leak (tokens x2)" with a single-click "view impacted tenants" and a dry-run toggle for guards (dry-run = create alerts but don't pause).
pm-raj: worried about auto-pausing around peak windows or scheduled migrations. propose a grace window: guard must be tripped for 10m before pause, and then a cooldown before auto-resume (exp backoff + manual override). also add an "ignore guards for scheduled maint" flag.
kevin: sounds good. we should treat cost-leak as one of multiple gates (latency p95 > 200ms, error-rate >0.5%, token-cost spike). any gate -> auto-pause. on pause: open pager (or paged alert) to oncall + webhooks to tenant owner + annotate rollout.
yang: telemetry requirements: per-route + model-version token meters (tokens_in_request, tokens_generated), sample by tenant id, store aggregates at 1m resolution. need pre/post-quantization token estimate for accurate cost delta. retention 90d for debugging, 7d hot.
maria: questions for infra: can we compute p95 on the ingest stream with our current summarizers? if not, we fallback to approximate t-digest. also add min-sample check before guard evaluates.
kevin: followups: 1) edge: implement min-traffic (=50 rps) + p95 comparison + grace window 10m; 2) console: timeline message + dry-run toggle + manual resume button; 3) telemetry: 1m buckets for tokens, mark pre/post-quantization. i'll draft the RFC and tag infra/telemetry owners. :thumbsup:
console-team: we'll mock the paused state in the rollout UI and add a resume confirmation modal (require reason). we can wire the dry-run toggle to the rollout-config API.
pm-raj: sgtm, please include a short rollback playbook in RFC (when pause is not enough).
maria: ack. assigning kevin for RFC, yang for telemetry spec, sophie/console-team for UI mocks.
kevin: thanks — i'll post the RFC by EOD tomorrow and include example config schema and sample alerts.
